title: Inverse-image comparison map for sheaves of roots of unity
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] and $N\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$. On the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] let $\mu_{N,Y}$, $\mu_{N,X}$ be the sheaves of $N$-th roots of unity [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf], $\mu_{N,Y}(V)=\{u\in\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)^\times:u^N=1\}$, and let $f^{-1}$, $f_*$ be the inverse and direct image of pro-etale sheaves with the adjunction $f^{-1}\dashv f_*$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], $f_*\mathcal G(V)=\mathcal G(X\times_YV)$. For an object $V\to Y$ of $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ let $\mathrm{pr}_V:X\times_YV\to V$ be the second projection, and define

$$
 \beta^f_N(V):\mu_{N,Y}(V)\longrightarrow\mu_{N,X}(X\times_YV)=(f_*\mu_{N,X})(V),\qquad u\longmapsto\mathrm{pr}_V^\sharp(u),
$$

where $\mathrm{pr}_V^\sharp:\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)\to\Gamma(X\times_YV,\mathcal O)$ is the ring map on global sections [def-pur-proetale-structure-sheaf]; it sends units to units and $N$-th roots of unity to $N$-th roots of unity, is a group homomorphism, and commutes with the restriction maps along morphisms $V'\to V$ over $Y$ (functoriality of global sections), so $\beta^f_N:\mu_{N,Y}\to f_*\mu_{N,X}$ is a morphism of sheaves of abelian groups. The *inverse-image comparison map of roots of unity* is its adjoint

$$
 c^f_{\mu_N}:f^{-1}\mu_{N,Y}\longrightarrow\mu_{N,X},
$$

a morphism of sheaves of abelian groups on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$. For $N\mid N'$ the comparison maps of $\mu_{N'}$ and $\mu_N$ are related through the transition maps $t_{N',N}:u\mapsto u^{N'/N}$ of [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf] (that $t_{N',N}\circ c^f_{\mu_{N'}}=c^f_{\mu_N}\circ f^{-1}(t_{N',N})$, and that $c^f_{\mu_N}$ is an isomorphism when $f$ is one, is [lem-pur-roots-of-unity-inverse-image-iso]).

source.place: (2.2), pp. 280-281 (the groups Z/l^n(1) of roots of unity, on which automorphisms act by transport of structure); construction written out by the worker, the comparison map being the one called 'the functorial pullback of roots of unity' in literature/blueprint/master/blueprint/sec-algebraic-groups-lie-algebras/ (node lem-wf-tate-twist-compatibility)
